name: Map_apObjects0
comment: Raw first object-pointer slot at Map base0x1139B8+0x108. Tact_InitMission loads this pointer at0x3CB28 and stores it into empty-item sentinel0x138EA0 at0x3CB30. Three death-blast neighbor calls also use this slot; own-cell uses slot17 at+0x14C. Existing table capacity/type is retained, not re-proved here.
